task.title: Open a family tree file
task.shortdesc: Bring a tree from another program, or a copy from a relative, into uFTi.

context.p: A family tree file ends in .ged or .gdz. Put the file on your first, for example in Downloads. works on its own copy, so the file you choose stays as it was. says more.

cmd.ph: Choose in the list on the left, then .

stepresult.p: Android's own screen for choosing a file opens. It starts at Recent. Its menu, the three lines at the top left, has Downloads.

step.cmd: Open the folder that holds the file, such as Downloads, and choose the file.

stepresult.p: If made the file, a box names the tree and counts the people, families, events, sources and notes in it, and its pictures. It says uFTi keeps its own copy; the file you chose is left as it was.
If another program made the file, a page opens first. It says the file was not made by , and asks what the app may do with it.

step.cmd: For a file that another program made, choose or .

choices.choice: keeps a copy of its own in GEDCOM 7, and saves your changes there. The file you chose is not touched.

opens the tree to look at, and the file is not touched. The box that follows says Opened to look at: uFTi will not change this file. Home then says that nothing in the tree can be changed, and the button is gone. On , its card is marked . To change the tree, choose on its card. The copy opens at once, and you can change it.

stepresult.p: opens for the new tree, and it has a card on , marked .

result.p: The card of the tree in use comes first. The cards sit side by side. To use another tree, choose on its card; says more. Choose on a card to see which file it is.
result.note: A card takes its name from the file. If you already have a tree of that name, the new card's name ends in a number, such as (2).
